# Manos de Confianza

> Trusted renovation and maintenance for foreign property owners in Spain. Verified builders, design proposals, daily progress video and coordination in the owner's own language. Part of the Key4Spain network, invoiced by Lyfion S.L.

## What it is
Manos de Confianza coordinates renovation and maintenance for people who own property in Spain but often do not live there. The owner sends one message; Manos de Confianza turns it into a plan, selects the right trades, agrees the builder, price and scope in person at the property, runs the schedule and sends a daily progress video so the owner can follow the work remotely.

## Areas served
Valencia, Alicante, Costa Blanca (Comunidad Valenciana, Spain).

## Languages
Spanish and English. The site is bilingual (ES / EN).

## How it works
- Design proposal (optional): the owner sends photos and ideas; designers return a visual of how the space could look. Nothing is decided online.
- Agreed in person: builder, price and scope are agreed at the property, face to face. No blind quotes.
- Daily progress video: once work is agreed the owner does not need to be present; they receive a video of the work every day, from demolition to finish.

## Services
- Reformas / Renovation (interior): full apartments, bathrooms, kitchens, flooring, painting, electrics, plumbing, damp and sealing, windows and doors, carpentry, tiling, air conditioning.
- Mantenimiento / Maintenance: repairs, small jobs, seasonal check-ups, property watch while away, emergency call-out, for houses and apartments.
- Exteriores / Outdoors: gardens, yards and patios, terraces, exterior painting, fencing and gates, outdoor lighting, paving.
- Pools (coming soon): pool building and care.

## Flagship promise
"See your home renovated, before you spend a euro." Owners send a few photos and receive a realistic visual of the finished result, so they can decide with their own eyes.
